::: {.about-content}

::: {.about-intro}
Hello! I'm originally from **Dhaka**, the vibrant capital city of Bangladesh. I came to the US in 2015 in pursuit of my bachelor's degree in Computer Science and lived in West Michigan before moving to Northern Virginia in 2022. 

I am currently a **Data Analyst II** at Shift Digital in the Data Operations and Analytics team, where I leverage data-driven solutions for enterprise clients. I graduated with a **Master's of Science in Data Science & Analytics** from Georgetown University in 2025. My passion lies in leveraging tailored data and algorithms to solve intricate business problems and communicating complex insights to non-technical stakeholders.

I love spending time in charming cafes and exploring new cuisines. During my downtime I enjoy reading, painting and watching movies/TV shows.
:::

```{python}
# Timeline data organized chronologically

        'description': 'Aerospace software verification and web development'
    },
    {
        'year': '2021-2023',
        'title': 'Data Analyst I',
        'organization': 'Shift Digital',
        'location': 'Birmingham, MI',
        'type': 'work',
        'description': 'Data operations and analytics for enterprise clients'
    },
    {
        'year': '2023-2025',
        'title': 'Master of Science in Data Science and Analytics',
        'organization': 'Georgetown University',
        'location': 'Washington, D.C.',
        'type': 'education',
        'description': 'Advanced data science and analytics specialization'
    },
    {
        'year': '2025-Present',
        'title': 'Data Analyst II',
        'organization': 'Shift Digital',
        'location': 'Birmingham, MI',
        'type': 'work',
        'description': 'Leading analytics initiatives and mentoring team members'
    }
]

fig = go.Figure()

# Define colors
colors = {
    'education': '#4A90E2',  # Professional blue
    'work': '#7ED321'       # Fresh green
}

# Create vertical timeline
for i, item in enumerate(timeline_data):
    y_pos = len(timeline_data) - i - 1  # Reverse order (newest at top)
    color = colors[item['type']]
    
    # Timeline dot with custom hover styling
    fig.add_trace(go.Scatter(
        x=[0],
        y=[y_pos],
        mode='markers',
        marker=dict(
            size=16,
            color=color,
            line=dict(width=3, color='white'),
            symbol='circle'
        ),
        hovertemplate=(
            f"<b style='color:white'>{item['title']}</b><br>"
            f"<span style='color:white'>{item['organization']}</span><br>"
            f"<span style='color:white'>{item['location']}</span><br>"
            f"<span style='color:white'>{item['year']}</span><br>"
            f"<i style='color:white'>{item['description']}</i>"
            "<extra></extra>"
        ),
        hoverlabel=dict(
            bgcolor=color,
            font=dict(color='white', size=12, family='Inter, Arial, sans-serif'),
            bordercolor='white'
        ),
        showlegend=False
    ))
    
    # Title and organization (right side) - using class for responsive control
    fig.add_annotation(
        x=0.15,
        y=y_pos + 0.15,
        text=f"<b>{item['title']}</b>",
        showarrow=False,
        font=dict(size=14, color='#2C3E50', family='Inter, Arial, sans-serif'),
        xanchor='left',
        yanchor='middle',
        name='title-text'
    )
    
    fig.add_annotation(
        x=0.15,
        y=y_pos - 0.05,
        text=f"{item['organization']}",
        showarrow=False,
        font=dict(size=12, color='#5D6D7E', family='Inter, Arial, sans-serif'),
        xanchor='left',
        yanchor='middle',
        name='org-text'
    )
    
    fig.add_annotation(
        x=0.15,
        y=y_pos - 0.25,
        text=f"{item['location']}",
        showarrow=False,
        font=dict(size=10, color='#85929E', family='Inter, Arial, sans-serif'),
        xanchor='left',
        yanchor='middle',
        name='location-text'
    )
    
    # Year (left side)
    fig.add_annotation(
        x=-0.15,
        y=y_pos,
        text=f"<b>{item['year']}</b>",
        showarrow=False,
        font=dict(size=11, color='#34495E', family='Inter, Arial, sans-serif'),
        xanchor='right',
        yanchor='middle',
        name='year-text'
    )

# Vertical timeline line
fig.add_trace(go.Scatter(
    x=[0, 0],
    y=[-0.5, len(timeline_data) - 0.5],
    mode='lines',
    line=dict(color='#D5DBDB', width=3),
    showlegend=False,
    hoverinfo='skip'
))

# Legend
fig.add_trace(go.Scatter(
    x=[None], y=[None],
    mode='markers',
    marker=dict(size=12, color=colors['education']),
    name='Education',
    showlegend=True
))

fig.add_trace(go.Scatter(
    x=[None], y=[None],
    mode='markers',
    marker=dict(size=12, color=colors['work']),
    name='Professional Experience',
    showlegend=True
))

# Layout with desktop defaults
fig.update_layout(
    showlegend=True,
    legend=dict(
        orientation="h",
        yanchor="bottom",
        y=-0.15,
        xanchor="center",
        x=0.5,
        font=dict(size=11, family='Inter, Arial, sans-serif')
    ),
    plot_bgcolor='rgba(0,0,0,0)',
    paper_bgcolor='rgba(0,0,0,0)',
    height=400,
    margin=dict(l=100, r=200, t=20, b=60),
    xaxis=dict(
        showgrid=False,
        showticklabels=False,
        zeroline=False,
        range=[-0.4, 1]
    ),
    yaxis=dict(
        showgrid=False,
        showticklabels=False,
        zeroline=False,
        range=[-0.5, len(timeline_data) - 0.5]
    )
)

# Configure for responsive display
config = {
    'responsive': True,
    'displayModeBar': False,
    'showTips': False
}

fig.show(config=config)
```

::: {#timeline-responsive-script}
<script>
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
    function adjustTimelineLayout() {
        const timelineContainer = document.querySelector('.journey-visual .plotly-graph-div');
        if (!timelineContainer) return;
        
        const screenWidth = window.innerWidth;
        let newLayout = {};
        
        if (screenWidth <= 480) {
            // Very small mobile
            newLayout = {
                height: 300,
                margin: {l: 25, r: 80, t: 20, b: 60},
                'xaxis.range': [-0.2, 0.6]
            };
        } else if (screenWidth <= 768) {
            // Mobile/tablet
            newLayout = {
                height: 350,
                margin: {l: 40, r: 120, t: 20, b: 60},
                'xaxis.range': [-0.3, 0.8]
            };
        } else {
            // Desktop
            newLayout = {
                height: 400,
                margin: {l: 100, r: 200, t: 20, b: 60},
                'xaxis.range': [-0.4, 1]
            };
        }
        
        // Apply the layout changes
        if (window.Plotly && timelineContainer._fullLayout) {
            Plotly.relayout(timelineContainer, newLayout);
        }
    }
    
    // Initial adjustment
    setTimeout(adjustTimelineLayout, 500);
    
    // Adjust on window resize
    let resizeTimeout;
    window.addEventListener('resize', function() {
        clearTimeout(resizeTimeout);
        resizeTimeout = setTimeout(adjustTimelineLayout, 300);
    });
});
</script>
:::
